title: Pytania 2
note: Second question-word wave, completing a1_questions (co/gdzie/jak/czy already own that ground and are only recycled here). THREE new things: (1) dlaczego + bo taught as a pair on purpose — a question you can answer is worth twice one you can't. (2) kiedy — when. (3) ktory/ktora/ktore — Nominative ONLY, taught as the exact same gender-test reflex as ten/ta/to (structure ten_ta_to, a1_gender_gym): ktory matches ten, ktora matches ta, ktore matches to. FENCED: no case forms of ktory beyond Nominative (ktorego/ktorej/ktorym are B1+), no relative clauses (film, ktory... is B1), no indirect questions (Nie wiem, kiedy... is B1). Every ktory/ktora/ktore sentence in this pack keeps the word in SUBJECT position (Ktory film jest dobry?) so it never has to take an object case — that boundary is never even hinted at to the learner beyond one quarantine line in the intro, matching the a2_shopping_func 'Place karta' / a2_ordinals_time 'o trzeciej' precedent of naming the fence without explaining the machinery behind it. HOMOGRAPH CHECK (POOL + check_new): ktora is already in POOL, taught by a2_ordinals_time inside the frozen chunk 'ktora godzina' (what time is it) — same word, same function (interrogative, feminine nominative, agreeing with a feminine noun), not a homograph mismatch, so it is RECYCLED here rather than re-taught: it does not appear in teaches_lemmas, only in uses_lemmas, and the intro explicitly points back to 'ktora godzina' as the anchor the learner already has. ktory and ktore are genuinely new and are taught. ktorej (genitive/locative, taught by a2_ordinals_time only as the frozen chunk 'o ktorej' = at what time, never explained as a case form) is deliberately NOT reused here at all, precisely because reusing it would dress up a case form as if it were part of the Nominative-only paradigm this unit teaches — safer to leave it untouched. ILE CHECK: ile (how much/how many) is already in POOL, taught by a2_shopping_func (Ile to kosztuje?, Ile kosztuje kawa?) and seeded even earlier via the frozen chunk 'Ile masz lat?'. It is NOT re-taught here — one intro recap line names it and moves on; it carries no teaches_lemmas entry and no dedicated match/quiz/type/use items, only a mention in uses_lemmas. All verbs imperfective, all forms already in POOL (present_uje: pracuje/pracujesz; present_e_isz: lubi; present_e_esz: pije; musiec: musze; byc_adj: zmeczony/zmeczona, dobry/dobra/dobre; existential_jest: jest + subject for 'when is the film'). dobry/dobra/dobre (a1_gender_check) is used deliberately as the predicate adjective across all three ktory/ktora/ktore sentences so the two closed 3-gender sets line up side by side — the clearest 'live application of the gender work' available in POOL.

intro.title: Dlaczego? and bo — learn them as a pair
intro.body:
Dlaczego? means "Why?". Bo means "because".

They are taught together on purpose. A question you can actually answer is worth twice one you can't — so every time you meet dlaczego, you get bo in the same breath.

intro.title: Kiedy? — when
intro.body: Kiedy means "when". It asks about a point in time, in general — a different job from o której, which you already have for a fixed clock hour (o trzeciej). Kiedy is the wider question; o której is the narrow one.

intro.title: Który / która / które — the same test as ten / ta / to
intro.body:
You already have a reflex for checking a noun's gender: ten dom, ta kawa, to piwo. Który/która/które is built on exactly that reflex — it just means "which" instead of "this".

Który matches ten. Która matches ta — and you have actually met która before, in która godzina? ("what time is it?"). Które matches to.

Same three endings you already sort by ear, doing a new job.
intro.body_pl: Który = jak ten. Która = jak ta (znasz z która godzina?). Które = jak to.

intro.title: Który / która / które in a real sentence
intro.body: Put który/która/które at the front, followed by the noun, and ask about it. In this unit it always stands as the subject, the same way ten/ta/to did — that keeps it simple. Ktory changes its ending after other verbs, but that is a later unit; for now it is always który jest, która jest, które jest.
intro.body_pl: Który film jest dobry? Która kawa jest dobra? Które piwo jest dobre?

intro.title: Ile — already yours
intro.body:
One more question word belongs in this family, and you already have it: ile ("how much / how many"). You met it at the very start — Ile masz lat? — and again in the shop — Ile kosztuje kawa?

No new teaching here. This unit's job was the other three: dlaczego (+ bo), kiedy, and który/która/które.
intro.body_pl: Ile już znasz: Ile masz lat? Ile kosztuje kawa?

quiz.explain: Bo answers a dlaczego question — the two are learned as a pair.
Film is masculine — the same test you already run with ten film. Który matches ten.
Kawa is feminine — ta kawa, która kawa. It is the same word you already know from która godzina?
Piwo is neuter — to piwo, które piwo.
Kawa is feminine, so it needs która, not który — exactly as it needs ta, not ten.
Bo gives the reason — it is the only one of the four that can answer a dlaczego question.

type_items.explain: Same word you already use in która godzina? — feminine nouns take która, the way they take ta.

use_items.prompt_en: Type the exchange: — Why is dad tired? — Because dad is working.
use_items.answer: — Dlaczego tata jest zmęczony? — Bo tata pracuje.

use_items.prompt_en: Type the exchange: — Why does Anna like coffee? — Because the coffee is good.
use_items.answer: — Dlaczego Anna lubi kawę? — Bo kawa jest dobra.

use_items.explain: Kawa jest dobra uses the same dobry/dobra/dobre set you are about to see line up against który/która/które.

use_items.prompt_en: Type the exchange: — When is the film? — In the evening.

use_items.explain: Film is masculine, so both który and dobry take the plain masculine ending — the same shape as ten film, dobry film.
Piwo is neuter, so który and dobry both switch to their neuter form: które, dobre.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: Why does mum like tea?
